subject: Post-demo: stakeholder ladder & contract flow for NovaMed
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@novamed.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: stakeholder ladder & contract flow for NovaMed

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the time and the clear signal on problem areas (latency for batch reports, PI handling in clinical workflows). Quick recap and a proposed contract routing path so procurement and security have visibility into next steps: 

1) Stakeholders we noted on the call (please correct):
   - Product / buyer contact: Alicia Gomez (you)
   - Security technical: Tom Reynolds
   - Procurement inbox: procurement@novamed.com (we don't have a named rep yet)

2) Proposed decision ladder / ownership (internal to us):
   - Economic/contract approvals: TBD (please confirm who signs contracts)
   - Redwood owners: Ben Carter (legal/redlines), Monica Patel (commercial & procurement ops)

3) Suggested contract sequencing (to minimize cycles):
   - NDA (if required) — quick one-page template to confirm PII scope (1 business day turnaround)
   - DPA (data processing addendum) — security scoping and minimal redlines (3 business days per round)
   - MSA (commercial terms + SOW) — redline round(s) (we typically plan for 3–5 business days per round depending on complexity)

4) Action items / asks for NovaMed:
   - Please confirm the economic buyer (name and email) so we can route approvals and paperwork to the right person.
   - Share the procurement contact (name + any PO or playbook notes).
   - Tom: can you confirm the security docs you need (SOC 2, DPA template, encryption details)?

Attachments: call notes (2026-10-04-novamed-call-notes.pdf), draft MSA redline stub (redline-novamed-msa-v1.docx) attached for internal tracking.

If you prefer, we can sequence NDA -> DPA -> MSA but open the MSA redline in parallel to speed review. Proposed internal owners (Ben/Monica) will pick up redlines and coordinate with you.

Next: If you confirm economic buyer and procurement contact today, I will:
- Kick off an NDA DocuSign (if needed)
- Upload SOC 2 to the shared Drive link
- Open a HubSpot deal and set milestone for procurement review (see link)

Thanks — Nikhil

--
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nsharma@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@novamed.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder ladder & contract flow for NovaMed

Nikhil — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer / person who will sign: Dana Lee (CFO) — dana.lee@novamed.com. She will want a short ROI / spend justification ahead of the spend committee (targeting Q4).
- Procurement lead: please loop procurement@novamed.com — our contracts coordinator is often Priya Rao (p.rao@novamed.com) but sometimes an assigned buyer opens the PO. I cc'd procurement in case they want to assign a specific rep.
- Sequence sounds fine. We typically want the DPA scoped in parallel with MSA redlines so security can review data flows early.

Can you upload the SOC 2 and a short one-pager of your data residency + retention defaults? That will help our security review.

Also, FYI, our internal committee meets Oct 22; ideally we'd have commercial terms and security greenlight before that date to keep to Q4 procurement.

Alicia
VP Product, NovaMed
agomez@novamed.com | +1 212-555-4422

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novamed.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T13:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder ladder & contract flow for NovaMed

Nikhil / Alicia — quick security note: 

- We will need your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and an attestation on encryption at rest/in transit. Please indicate whether key management is customer-controlled or vendor-controlled.
- For the DPA: our security team will want a standard set of clauses (data subject requests, breach notification within 72 hours, subprocessors list). If you have a validated DPA template, please share.
- Security contact on our side (for DPA tech questions) is Priya Rao (p.rao@novamed.com). She should be able to coordinate with your security/ops.

Ben — looping you for redline expectations; on our side we try to limit commercial redlines and focus changes in risk/indemnity and data controls.

Tom
Director of Information Security, NovaMed

From: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@novamed.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder ladder & contract flow for NovaMed — plan and owners

Thanks — clear and helpful input. Summary / mutual action plan and internal owners below: 

Stakeholder confirmations (NovaMed):
- Economic signatory: Dana Lee <dana.lee@novamed.com> (confirmed by Alicia)
- Security reviewer: Tom Reynolds / Priya Rao (p.rao@novamed.com)
- Procurement inbox: procurement@novamed.com

Redwood owners (to NovaMed):
- Legal / redlines: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai)
- Commercial / procurement coordination: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.ai)
- AE / primary contact: Nikhil Sharma (nsharma@redwood.ai)

Planned sequencing (to minimize round-trips):
1) NDA: optional. If you prefer, we can send a one-page mutual NDA via DocuSign today. Target turnaround: 1 business day.
2) SOC 2 + DPA: we will upload SOC 2 to Drive and share a DPA template. Target DPA review cadence: ~3 business days per review cycle (security-focused).
3) MSA redline: open redline now (attached v1). Target first-pass response: 3–5 business days. If the DPA is being negotiated in parallel, Ben will triage overlap items with Monica.

Attachments uploaded to Drive and included in this thread: 2026-10-04-novamed-call-notes.pdf; redline-novamed-msa-v1.docx.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
- Nikhil: Upload SOC 2 to Drive and send DocuSign NDA (today) — ETA EOD PT.
- Ben: Start MSA redline triage and prepare comments for Dana + procurement (ETA 48–72 hrs).
- Monica: Draft commercial summary / spend justification doc for Dana (ETA 72 hrs).
- Alicia / NovaMed: Confirm whether NDA is required and whether procurement will assign a named buyer.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/75432/HM-3421 (I populated milestones for NDA -> Security -> Commercial -> Exec approval).

If this plan looks good I will: 1) send the NDA envelope, 2) share SOC 2 in Drive, and 3) tag Ben/Monica on the redline doc.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving toward Oct 22 committee.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
